ValidationRule.description: Only allow changes for an In progress case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Expense' && $Profile.Name <> 'System Admin - Lite' && $Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator' &&$Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator - Freight' &&$Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator - Global' &&$Profile.Name <> 'CRM Administrator - QCC' && $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - Freight' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - QCC' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - SND' && $Profile.Name <> 'API Profile QCC Connected/QCC GW Integration' && WorkOrder.Case.OwnerId <> $User.Id && NOT(ISPICKVAL(WorkOrder.Case.Status,'In Progress'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Changes can be made only for an In Progress Case by the Case Owner
